projects.name: Automation
details: • Core objective is to enhance the CITIFT application for Foreign Exchange (FX) automation
• Key functional areas include passive FX flow handling, value date management, FX cut-off processing and
dedicated FX repair queues
• Involved in functional requirement analysis and solution design for FX automation in payment systems
• Created FRD, epics, and user stories for payment and FX change requests
• Implemented automated FX rate sourcing and validation for cross-border and high-value payments
• Improved Straight Through Processing (STP) and reduced manual intervention
• Performed payment trace analysis, RCA, and defect triaging
• Collaborated with Product, Technology, partner systems and Operations teams for solution delivery
• Supported UAT and production readiness activities
• Supported internal automation team with functional and configuration expertise
• Created static data set up based on the Requirement

projects.name: MT191 Implementation
details: • This project enhances the CITIFT system to efficiently handle incoming MT191 charge message from
China’s CIPS system
• It focuses on ensuring accurate receipt, parsing and mapping of MT191 transaction fields, followed by
matching them with original MT100/103 payments
• Functional Analysis of requirement from Ops & Product Team, Providing walk through for implemented
solution to stakeholders
• Provided Analysis for the defect raised into scrum Board and logs analysis if defect require any set up fix
and Functional assistant to developers for any defect fix
• Created User stories for the CITIFT changes.
• Involved in scrum ceremonies, retrospective and maintaining scrum board.
• Provided High level walk-through to the stake-holders for the changes before implementation and before
Go live
• Led end-to-end implementation of MT191 charge message processing
• Enabled MT191 to MT202 conversion with accounting and compliance checks
• Ensured OFAC/sanction screening compliance
• Handled duplicate and unmatched transaction scenarios
• Delivered project with zero escalation
Finastra / Xoriant

details: • Worked on SWIFT High Value Payments and ISO 20022 processing using GPP SP

• Product: GPP SP 4.6.15 and 4.6.17
